extName.description: The extension name shown in the browser toolbar, the extensions page, and the install dialog. 'Nox' is the brand name (the Roman goddess of night) and should NOT be translated.

extDescription.message: Erzwingt den Dunkelmodus auf jeder Website – auch dort, wo der integrierte Dunkelmodus des Browsers versagt, wie bei GitHub und Google Docs.
extDescription.description: Short description shown on the extensions page and the store listing.

popupTitle.description: Window title of the toolbar popup.

toggleAriaLabel.description: Invisible screen-reader (accessibility) label for the on/off switch.

statusEnabled.description: Label shown next to the toggle when dark mode is ON.

statusDisabled.description: Label shown next to the toggle when dark mode is OFF.

ignoreSite.description: Button: add the current site to the ignore list so it keeps its original (light) theme.

stopIgnoring.description: Button: remove the current site from the ignore list so dark mode applies to it again.
